title: Agent task checkpoint
description: One long-running agent task, saved as .agent-state/<task-id>.json and updated after every meaningful step, so that a fresh session can resume it. scripts/agent-resume.sh validates files against these rules, plus two a schema cannot state (every timestamp is a real time; a null current_step means every step is completed), and cross-checks them with git and gh. scripts/agent-resume.test.mjs reads the required and allowed properties from this file and checks each pattern-based rejection against the patterns here.

goal.description: What the task is for, in a sentence a fresh session can act on.

plan_steps.description: The ordered steps. Steps are referred to by their 1-based position.

current_step.description: The 1-based step in progress; null once every step is completed.

completed_steps.description: The steps finished so far, each recorded when it finished.

note.description: Evidence: a commit, a PR, a command and its result.

pushed.description: Whether the branch has been pushed to origin, as the task last knew it.

next_action.description: The very next thing to do. May be empty only when current_step is null.

updated_at.description: When the file was last written, in UTC.
